goalTranslation.businessGoal: A room-scoped voice/chat agent completes user-assigned tasks (research, documents, spreadsheets) end to end without a human babysitting the run

tiers.action: read/draft voice commands (classifyRisk returns read|draft, src/voice/commandClassifier.ts)
write/destructive voice commands (commandRequiresConfirmation gates riskLevel write|destructive behind awaiting_confirmation, src/voice/commandClassifier.ts:139-146)
credit-spending agent actions flagged requiresApproval: true (src/nodeagent/core/creditModel.ts:170)

interception.how: sanitizeProviderError (src/nodeagent/models/providerParserLive.ts:214) strips provider payloads/keys before any error reaches the user or the agent's own reasoning

fallback.description: After retries, adapter.ts tries fallbackModelFor (src/nodeagent/models/adapter.ts:215) for a cross-model retry; if that also fails the room shows a sanitized failed-run state instead of a raw provider error

slos.rationale: scripts/slo-gate.ts thresholds over 8 scripted room runs
scripts/slo-gate.ts p95RunMs threshold; p95, not p99 — see production-agent.gaps.md

circuitBreaker.onTrip: A single failed call on a free route starts a per-model cooldown: base 5min doubling per consecutive failure, capped at 30min (src/nodeagent/models/openRouterFreeModels.ts:285-287); routing falls over to the next healthy free model

costFuse.onTrip: Run aborts when spendLimits trip: maxTokens 250000 or maxCostUsd 2 per run (convex/agent.ts:641-645). Note: the USD fuse is per-run, not per-day, so it lives in this text rather than maxSpendUsdPerDay

judgeRegression.command: npm run media:gemini-judge — nightly cron '0 9 * * *' plus workflow_dispatch in .github/workflows/nightly-judge.yml; schedule-only because the judge spends Gemini tokens. Trigger field omitted: the schema enum has no 'scheduled' value and declaring on-commit/on-pr/pre-deploy would be false (see production-agent.gaps.md)
